source: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR
evidenceBoundary: These records reproduce or compare official SEC disclosures. A filing does not prove motive, investment merit, present ownership, coordination or wrongdoing. Form 13F differences do not reveal exact trade dates or execution prices.

methodology.form4: Parse official ownership XML and preserve each reported transaction code, acquired/disposed indicator, shares, price, post-transaction holdings and direct/indirect ownership.
methodology.form13f: Parse official 13F information-table XML and compare consecutive quarter-end reports by manager, CUSIP, class and put/call status.
methodology.ranking: Open-market purchase and sale codes are kept separate from awards, exercises, gifts, tax withholding and other transaction codes.
